name: Quick Pro ER:ONE
why_interesting: A 7.1 kg claimed complete aero-road build with Ultegra Di2 and an official global list price.
missing: Dated mainland-China RMB checkout observation and purchase route
Mainland delivery, duties, returns, and warranty-handling confirmation
source_note: The current official global storefront lists US$4,999 and a 7.1 kg ±5% carbon-spoke build. The converted CNY amount is not a mainland checkout, and exact wheel selection remains buyer-configurable.

facts.complete_weight_basis: Current exact manufacturer claim for the ER:ONE Ultegra Di2 complete build with carbon-spoke wheels: 7.1 kg ±5%; size and selected RORE wheel model are unspecified
facts.stiffness_evidence: An independent exact-model owner review reports immediate power response and very high perceived stiffness, while noting that carbon-spoke wheels contribute to the setup. Qualitative ride evidence only, not an instrumented frame-isolation protocol.

support_note: Official support page states a five-year frameset warranty for the original purchaser, one-year Shimano/SRAM coverage on complete bikes, mostly assembled delivery, and typical standard-bike delivery around three weeks; mainland-China service and delivery are not confirmed.
price_status: Current official global US$4,999 Ultegra Di2 checkout converted to CNY; mainland checkout, selected wheels, shipping and tax unverified

observed_price.price_basis: Current exact ER:ONE Ultegra Di2 official global-store amount converted at the dated central-parity reference
observed_price.conditions: Reference only; selected wheel option, size, finish, shipping, tax, duties, actual FX, stock and mainland checkout are unverified
